title: How Labubu Became a Must-have Luxury Accessory, and Why ‘Prices May Fluctuate’
titleZh: Labubu是怎样卷入时尚工业的
summary:
Labubu诞生于北欧民间传说与艺术家Kasing Lung的奇思妙想，2015年，它在绘本故事《The Monsters》中首次登场。这个长着尖耳朵、咧嘴嬉笑、有些调皮的精灵角色，在四年后，经由中国品牌泡泡玛特（Pop Mart）的推动，成功化身为收藏级玩具，如今正逐步在奢饰品市场占据一席之地。

来源：WWD（女装日报）；作者：Renan Botelho；原文发布时间：2025-05-30 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Born from Nordic folklore and the imagination of artist Kasing Lung, Labubu first appeared in 2015 as a character in “The Monsters” storybook. The mischievous elf with pointy ears and a toothy grin made its leap to collectible toy four years later, thanks to China’s Pop Mart, and is now conquering its space in the luxury market.
paragraphs.contentZh: Labubu诞生于北欧民间传说与艺术家Kasing Lung的奇思妙想，2015年，它在绘本故事《The Monsters》中首次登场。这个长着尖耳朵、咧嘴嬉笑、有些调皮的精灵角色，在四年后，经由中国品牌泡泡玛特（Pop Mart）的推动，成功化身为收藏级玩具，如今正逐步在奢饰品市场占据一席之地。

paragraphs.contentEn: With more than 1.4 million videos made about them on TikTok, the Labubu dolls reached a new peak in popularity in 2025, as search interest for the plush dolls surged exponentially on Google, and celebrities have begun to adopt the Labubu as an accessory. Rihanna, Dua Lipa, Post Malone and Blackpink’s Lisa are among the names who have recently shown their love for the toys publicly.
paragraphs.contentZh: 在TikTok上，关于Labubu的视频已超过140万条，谷歌上关于这款毛绒玩偶的搜索热度也呈指数级飙升，Labubu玩偶也由此早2025年迎来了新一轮的人气巅峰，与此同时，各路明星也开始将Labubu玩偶作为一种时尚配饰。蕾哈娜、杜阿·利帕、波兹·马龙，以及Blackpink成员Lisa，近期都在公开场合表达了对这款玩偶的喜爱。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Labubu has become more than just a collectible; it’s a bold statement of individual style,” Emily Brough, Pop Mart’s head of IP licensing, the Americas, told WWD via email. The global collectibles company has launched more than 300 styles of Labubu since 2019, including an extensive list of collaborations and the Labubucharms, which are now being clipped onto luxury bags and styled into custom couture, as seen during Paris Fashion Week in March.
paragraphs.contentZh: 泡泡玛特美洲区IP授权负责人艾米丽·布拉夫在回复《女装日报》（WWD）的邮件中表示：“Labubu早已不只是一个收藏玩偶，而是一种张扬个性风格的大胆宣言。”自2019年以来，这家全球性的收藏玩具公司已经推出了超过300款Labubu造型，包括许多联名系列以及Labubu挂件，在今年三月的巴黎时装周上，这些挂件被巧妙扣在奢侈品牌手袋上，甚至融入定制高级时装设计之中。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Labubu’s presence in the fashion space — from NYFW to appearances on luxury bags — reflects a broader cultural resonance,” Brough said, adding that Labubu, like other characters from Pop Mart, including Skullpanda and Peach Riot, are well-positioned to bridge collectibles and fashion. “We’re already seeing organic traction in this space through celebrity and stylist interest,” she said.
paragraphs.contentZh: 布拉夫指出：“Labubu在时尚领域的崭露头角——从纽约时装周的亮相到成为奢饰品手带上的热门配饰——体现了它更广泛的文化共鸣”，她补充说，Labubu与泡泡玛特旗下的其他角色，如Skullpanda和Peach Riot一样，在连接收藏玩具与时尚潮流之间具备天然优势。她表示：“随着明星和造型师的关注，我们已经注意到，这些角色在时尚领域的影响力正在自然增长。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Part of Labubu’s initial appeal was formed by Pop Mart’s blind-box strategy. The brand gained recognition for selling sealed packages containing collectible figures from a specific series. The key feature is that you do not know which figure you are getting until you open the box, adding to the buyer’s experience with a sense of surprise and discovery.
paragraphs.contentZh: Labubu最初的吸引力，部分来自泡泡玛特的“盲盒策略”。该品牌以售卖密封包装的系列收藏玩偶而声广为人知。其最大特点在于，在打开盒子之前，买家并不知道自己会抽到哪一款玩偶。这种不确定性为整个消费过程增添了惊喜与探索的乐趣。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Our blind-box format transforms a product into an experience, something to be shared, traded and talked about. It’s meant to be a constant sense of anticipation and community — and for newer IPs, it helps build immediate engagement,” Brough said. “Fans have come to expect a certain level of storytelling, detail and playfulness.” Each Pop Mart series includes a set of standard figures and at least one rarer, secret figure. The secret figures are harder to find and are highly sought-after by collectors.
paragraphs.contentZh: 布拉夫表示：“我们的盲盒模式将一件产品转变为一种集分享、交换和讨论价值于一体的体验。这种模式所营造出的，是一种持续的期待感和社群归属感——而对于新IP来说，这种形式更有助于快速激发消费者的参与热情。如今，粉丝已经开始期待产品具备一定的故事性、细节感与趣味性。”每一套泡泡玛特系列通常包含一组常规款和至少一款更加稀有的隐藏款。隐藏款玩偶更难获得，也因此成为收藏者眼中的热门目标。

paragraphs.contentEn: A standard blind box from Pop Mart was originally priced between $13 and $16. Recent releases of the Labubu dolls have seen price increases in the U.S., with the latest series costing $27.99. The increase was announced after Donald Trump issued tariffs on China, although the company doesn’t confirm if the new tariff policy influenced the price change.
paragraphs.contentZh: 泡泡玛特的标准盲盒起初定价在13至16美元之间。近期推出的Labubu玩偶在美国售价有所上调，最新系列定价为27.99美元。这次涨价是在唐纳德·特朗普对中国加征关税之后宣布的，不过泡泡玛特并未确认此次价格调整是否受到新关税政策的直接影响。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Affordability is a core part of our brand promise. We want fans to feel that they can discover and collect characters without a barrier to entry. While prices may fluctuate slightly based on material or complexity, we aim to keep core products in a price range that supports accessibility,” Brough said.
paragraphs.contentZh: 布拉夫表示：“亲民的定价始终是我们品牌承诺的核心之一。我们希望粉丝在探索和收集角色时不会感到有任何门槛。虽然产品价格可能会因材质或工艺复杂程度略有波动，但我们的目标是将核心产品维持在大众可负担的价格区间，确保其始终易于入手。”

paragraphs.contentEn: With the ever-increasing demand for Pop Mart toys online, Labubu became a highly sought-after item in the fashion world, with some styles being as hard to obtain as limited-edition sneakers or the classic Birkin bags. The scarcity favors resellers. On platforms like StockX and eBay, different styles of Labubu toys and accessories can be found for up to $3,134.
paragraphs.contentZh: 随着线上对泡泡玛特玩具的需求不断攀升，Labubu玩偶已经成为时尚界炙手可热的单品，部分款式的稀有程度堪比限量版球鞋或经典铂金包。而这种稀缺性也为二级市场的卖家创造了机会。在StockX、eBay等平台上，不同款式的Labubu玩偶及配件的转售价格最高已飙至3134美元。

paragraphs.contentEn: “We’re just getting started. New Labubu collections will continue to drop globally, with more cross-format releases and seasonal moments. At the same time, we’re expanding the reach of other Pop Mart IPs to ensure that every fan finds a character they connect with. From immersive retail environments to digital-first formats like Pop Mart Pop Blocks, we’re exploring new ways to bring our creative universe to life. The fandom is growing and so is the world we’re building for them,” Brough said.
paragraphs.contentZh: 布拉夫表示：“这一切才刚刚开始。全新的Labubu系列将持续在全球上线，带来更多跨形式的合作与季节限定款。同时，我们也在拓展泡泡玛特旗下其他IP的影响力，确保每一位爱好者都能找到与自己产生共鸣的角色。从沉浸式的线下零售空间，到如Pop Mart Pop Blocks这样的数字化互动形式，我们正不断探索将创意宇宙具象化的新方式。随着粉丝群体的不断壮大，我们为他们打造的世界也在同步扩展。”
